en: A colorful, multi-view postcard showing various scenes of a city including beaches filled with sunbathers, a vibrant public square or park, a lively restaurant or café, city streets with mid-20th-century architecture, and the coast of a sea. Text in Cyrillic in the center reads 'Варна', and the reverse confirms this as well as providing further Cyrillic text and a Latin transliteration: 'VARNA'.
